Chapter 1025: 29 Two Little Guys? (Requesting Monthly Pass)_3

Chapter 1025: Chapter 29 Two Little Guys? (Requesting Monthly Pass)_3

However, this has no real harm to the universe itself. The universe is nurtured by the Chaos Void and is protected by its rules. Even an unparalleled Great Saint cannot cause actual damage to the universe itself; at most, they can only hasten its entry into the Great Collapse.

The Great Collapse of the universe is a catastrophe, an apocalypse for the beings within it.

But to the universe itself, it is as simple as ‘taking a nap’ to rest and recover.

It’s just that because of Lin Yuan, the length of time the home universe will ‘sleep’ this time will be a bit longer.

…

Within the home universe.

Endless destructive forces permeated the void, and a seemingly ordinary wooden hut drifted amidst the chaos.

Any single trace of the destructive force was enough to obliterate a Dominator-level being. The combined power of countless destructive forces had already reached the level of the Chaos Realm.

Yet all these overwhelming destructive forces were silently neutralized and absorbed the moment they touched the seemingly ordinary wooden hut.

“Has the Galactic Supreme left?”

“Such immense power—how was such a massive true form cultivated?”

“Could it be that before reincarnation, the Galactic Supreme was an unparalleled Great Saint adept in corporeal strength?”

Within the wooden hut, two faint voices conversed—it was the two ultimate entities of the Robber Clan.

“Even the most terrifying Tribulations of Destruction cannot shake the Galactic Supreme, nor even delay him. I even suspect that with his strength, if he forcibly stayed within the universe, he could survive until the next Cosmic Era.”

The voices in the wooden hut exchanged words, filled with incredulity.

To rely solely on physical flesh and blood to withstand the boundless Tribulations of Destruction—what kind of concept is this?

“The universe is about to completely collapse; we must also prepare to enter slumber.” After a while of discussion, the two ultimate beings of the Robber Clan noticed that the surrounding space was becoming increasingly constricted.

“Indeed, it is time to sleep again.”

The other ultimate being of the Robber Clan nodded. They had experienced more than one Great Collapse and were well-acquainted with what would happen next.

“Who knows when we’ll see the Galactic Supreme again?”

The first being who had spoken let his thoughts wander. He sighed and said, “I have a feeling that the next time we hear the name of the Galactic Supreme, it might be when he has become the Galactic Great Saint, shaking the Chaos Void.”

“Shaking the Chaos Void?”

The other ultimate being of the Robber Clan agreed. Ordinary Chaos Venerables or even Chaos Great Saints could not achieve such a feat. To shake the Chaos Void, only those unparalleled Great Saints were capable.

…

Deep within the universe on the verge of total collapse.

Within the Xuanhuang Secret Realm, a single incarnation of Lin Yuan sat cross-legged.

As the universe approached its destruction, the size of the Xuanhuang Secret Realm rapidly shrank, finally maintaining an area of just a few hundred meters around.

Before the Great Collapse of the universe commenced, Lin Yuan had purposely left an incarnation behind in this Xuanhuang Secret Realm as a last resort for preserving his life.

The Xuanhuang Secret Realm was isolated from the causality of space and time. Even if Lin Yuan’s true form perished completely in the Chaos Void, the incarnation within the secret realm could use the life-preserving methods stored there to resurrect him.

Additionally, numerous forbidden treasures were hidden here, such as that single drop of ‘Blood of Time.’

So far, Lin Yuan had found no place safer than the Xuanhuang Secret Realm.

The Source World? Its safety was only relative to the powerful figures of the Chaos Void. However, dangers still existed there, such as the feudal lords and kings, or the eternal Fierce Sun that hung high over the heavens.

Placing the treasures in the Source World would indeed prevent the powerful entities of the Chaos Void from seizing them—this applied even to 13th-tier temporal beings—but the powerful figures in the Source World would not be similarly restricted.

The Moyu Tower Master had expended boundless time and effort to hunt down a wondrous temporal entity, refining it to form the ‘Blood of Time.’ Even within the Source World, this treasure was a supreme artifact of immense value, capable of inciting a bloody struggle among the feudal-level Heavenly Venerates.

…

Placing the ‘Blood of Time’ in the Xuanhuang Secret Realm was not only safe but also made it easier for Lin Yuan to retrieve it.

All he needed to do was control a creature from within the universe and have it toss the Blood of Time into the Eternal Spatial Rift.

The Blood of Time was not a living entity and therefore faced no restrictions upon leaving the universe.

…

“After today, I will no longer have the concept of a home universe.”

Lin Yuan’s true form stood outside the universe, quietly watching as his home universe traversed its final journey.

“World-Breaking Origin Force…”

Lin Yuan briefly sensed the accumulation of World-Breaking Origin Force during the universe’s Great Collapse, and a smile appeared on his face.

One million four hundred thirty-six thousand eight hundred twelve strands of World-Breaking Origin Force.

This was the total amount Lin Yuan had accumulated from the beginning of the Great Collapse until he entered the Chaos Void.

“So much…”

Lin Yuan felt a burst of joy. With such a vast reserve of World-Breaking Origin Force, he felt a deep sense of confidence. At least in his future usage, there would no longer be a need to scrape by or endlessly deliberate.

When he first descended into the Source World, Lin Yuan had carefully weighed the option of spending a mere hundred strands of World-Breaking Origin Force to save the original Yu Yan.

If it were now, there would be no need for such hesitation.

“From what I see now, remaining outside the universe doesn’t allow me to absorb the World-Breaking Origin Force emanating from its collapse?” Lin Yuan pondered internally.

Until he had exited the universe, the World-Breaking Origin Force had continued to accumulate rapidly. However, the moment he stepped into the Chaos Void, the accumulation came to an abrupt halt.

Bear in mind, the current universe had not yet fully disintegrated. Theoretically, there should still be remnants of World-Breaking Origin Force being released—perhaps in reduced quantities, but not completely vanishing.

“What a pity.”

Lin Yuan shook his head slightly. If amassing large amounts of World-Breaking Origin Force required entering a collapsing universe, then replicating such conditions presented significant challenges.

“Hmm?”

Lin Yuan scanned his surroundings, his senses extending outward. He detected two faint auras cautiously rushing away several million light-years in the distance.

“Two little ones?”

Lin Yuan gazed at the two cautious presences fleeing far away. One was a massive black ship, the other a Suspended Island.

The black ship and Suspended Island were vast, spanning millions of miles each, towering and immense.

But compared to Lin Yuan in his current state, they truly were no more than tiny specks.
